description: Exhaustive non-overlapping Unicode 18.0 code point partitions by Script, Block, and General_Category

rules.Cn: unassigned (includes noncharacters), not a font-test target
rules.Cs: surrogate code points, not standalone Unicode scalar values
rules.Cc: control code points; omitted from Unicode's 172,808 encoded character count
rules.Zzzz: Unknown script value, normally used for unassigned/private-use/surrogates
rules.No_Block: code point outside the named Unicode Blocks
rules.font_support: not determined; assigned characters may lack installed glyph fonts
rules.emoji_and_sequences: emoji properties and multi-code-point sequences are not included in this dataset
